claim: v3 denoising-dirty-documents with mixed routing (coder + aggregator = sonnet, everything else = haiku) reaches SILVER medal at $7.48 total, with a better score (0.0184) than the Phase 1 all-sonnet baseline (silver, 0.0249). Haiku is sufficient for the 7 non-bridge roles (setup, splitter, designer, evaluator, judge, selector, reviser) on image-denoising. The cost target ($4) was missed, primarily because v3 defaults to enable_evaluator=true while the Phase 1 baseline ran with enable_evaluator=false; $1.39 went to evaluator runs that the Phase 1 baseline did not have.
scope: Single Phase 2 run on denoising-dirty-documents (image-denoising-restoration family, n=1 with mixed routing). Compares against Phase 1 baselines: sonnet-everywhere silver ($5.31, 0.0249), opus-everywhere FAIL.

vs_phase1_sonnet_everywhere.verdict: X203 spent $2.17 more but achieved a BETTER score (closer to gold 0.0179 by 0.00648). The cost increase is fully explained by v3-default enable_evaluator=true running 2-3 evaluator passes per node (we did NOT explicitly set enable_evaluator:false in X203 YAML); the per-role savings from haiku on setup/splitter/designer/judge/selector/reviser are real but masked by the evaluator add-on.

comparison.minimum_viable_sonnet_pin: X203 supports: ONLY coder and aggregator need sonnet for this task family. Other 7 roles are haiku-sufficient. (E012 candidate experiment would probe if reviser+judge can also be haiku given X202's documented haiku weakness on submission shape — that was on detecting; denoising's submission format is per-image and may be easier.)

limitations: n=1. Need second denoising run with the same routing AND enable_evaluator:false to isolate the evaluator-cost confound from the routing claim.
Score 0.0184 is within 3% of gold (0.0179) — a single re-run with bigger search might cross the line. The 'silver' result understates how close this routing came to gold.

Did not test whether replacing aggregator=sonnet with aggregator=haiku also works on denoising; the X202 finding (haiku-everywhere malformed submission on detecting) suggests it might not, but denoising's submission shape is different (per-pixel image files, not a tabular CSV).

implications.policy_implication: Promotable for image-denoising-restoration family default routing — coder+aggregator=sonnet, everything else=haiku. But promotion is conditional on a confirmation run (n=2 rule). Author X211 (X203 re-run for confirmation) before policy.json update.
follow_up_experiments: X211: re-run X203's exact routing (n=2 confirmation)
X212: X203 routing + enable_evaluator:false explicitly (isolate the $1.39 evaluator overhead)
X213: aggregator=haiku on denoising (probe whether denoising's image-per-file submission shape tolerates haiku aggregator, unlike detecting's tabular CSV)

next_actions: Continue Phase 2 with X204 (leaf opus-coder + bigger search) — independent finding.
